arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean start, but it currently only shows your email address and a verified email — there's no information about who you are, what you do, or your interests. I'd suggest adding an "About Me" section, a portfolio or list of projects, and maybe a contact form. A bit more visual design (colors, images, a header) would also make it feel more welcoming. Hope this helps!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby — that's a great theme to build a blog around! Right now the site is quite minimal, so I'd suggest adding actual blog posts about your hiking adventures, photos from your trails, and maybe a section with tips or gear recommendations. Adding categories or a search feature would help readers explore your content. Keep it up!
